entries.title: Individual Savings Accounts (ISAs)
entries.why: Official multi-part guide: 2026/27 £20,000 allowance, four ISA types, eligibility, withdrawals, transfers, inherited allowance

entries.title: Lifetime ISA
entries.why: Official LISA rules: £4,000/yr limit, 25% bonus (max £1,000/yr), age 18-39 to open, 25% withdrawal charge and exemptions

entries.title: Junior Individual Savings Accounts (ISA)
entries.why: Official Junior ISA rules: £9,000 2026/27 limit, under-18 UK-resident eligibility, cash + stocks-and-shares types, access at 18

entries.title: Tax on savings interest
entries.why: Definitive Personal Savings Allowance figures (£1,000/£500/£0 by band), £5,000 starting rate for savings, reporting and reclaim rules

entries.title: Get help with savings if you're on a low income (Help to Save)
entries.why: Official Help to Save scheme: 50p-per-£1 bonus (max £1,200 over 4 years), £1-£50/month, Universal Credit eligibility, benefits interaction

entries.title: Interest on savings for children
entries.why: Official rule that >£100/yr interest on parental gifts is taxed as the parent's, with Junior ISA/CTF exemptions

entries.title: Child Trust Fund
entries.why: Official CTF rules for 2002-2011 cohort: £9,000/yr limit, tax-free status, maturity at 18, transfer to Junior ISA or adult ISA

entries.title: Workplace pensions
entries.why: Canonical GOV.UK guide on workplace pensions and auto-enrolment: joining, contribution rules, tax relief, protections, opting out and re-enrolment.

entries.title: The new State Pension
entries.why: Authoritative source for new State Pension eligibility (10 qualifying NI years) and current amount (full rate £241.30/week from April 2026), claiming, deferral and inheritance rules.

entries.title: Tax on your private pension contributions
entries.why: HMRC-owned rules on pension tax relief, the £60,000 annual allowance (incl. taper and MPAA), and the lump sum allowance (£268,275) that replaced the lifetime allowance.

entries.title: Check your State Pension age
entries.why: Official tool/page for State Pension age and Pension Credit qualifying age — the factual anchor for any 'when can I get it' question.

entries.title: Check your State Pension forecast
entries.why: Official service for a personal State Pension forecast: how much, when, and how to increase it (incl. filling NI gaps); BR19/Future Pension Centre alternatives.

entries.title: Voluntary National Insurance
entries.why: Authoritative rules and rates for paying voluntary Class 2/3 NI to fill record gaps and top up State Pension, including the 6-year deadline rules.

entries.title: Personal pensions
entries.why: Canonical GOV.UK guide to personal/stakeholder (defined contribution) pensions: choosing one, taking money (25% tax-free lump sum, annuity, flexi-access drawdown), help and complaints.

entries.title: Plan your retirement income
entries.why: GOV.UK overview tying together State, workplace and personal pension options with current rates (basic £184.90 / new £241.30 weekly from April 2026) and working-past-pension-age rules.

entries.title: Pension scams
entries.why: FCA consumer page on spotting and avoiding pension scams and checking the FS Register — the regulator's own guidance; FCA's general retirement-income consumer page now redirects to MoneyHelper, so this is its remaining pensions consumer anchor.

entries.title: Stamp Duty Land Tax
entries.why: HMRC's canonical multi-part SDLT guide with current thresholds (£125k residential, £300k first-time buyer relief up to £500k), rate bands 0-12%, surcharges, shared-ownership treatment, payment and refunds

entries.title: Support for Mortgage Interest (SMI)
entries.why: Official SMI guide with concrete rules: qualifying benefits, loan caps (£200k / £100k Pension Credit), 4.5% repayment interest rate, repayment triggers and application process

entries.title: Shared ownership homes: buying, improving and selling
entries.why: Official first-home scheme guide with hard eligibility figures (10-75% share, £80k/£90k London income caps), staircasing rules and rent calculation caps (RPI/CPI-linked)

entries.title: First Homes scheme: first-time buyer's guide
entries.why: Official First Homes guide with concrete facts: 30-50% discount, £80k/£90k income caps, post-discount price caps (£250k / £420k London), mortgage-for-half requirement, resale rules

entries.title: Mortgage Charter
entries.why: The authoritative source text of the Mortgage Charter itself — signatory lender commitments (temporary interest-only switch, term extension, repossession forbearance) agreed with HM Treasury and the FCA

entries.title: Help to Buy: Equity Loan
entries.why: Official page confirming the scheme is closed to new applicants in England, with exact rules for existing loans: 5 interest-free years, 1.75% then CPI+2% annual uplift, £1/month fee, 10% minimum part-repayment

entries.title: Support available for mortgages as interest rates rise
entries.why: FCA consumer page setting out regulator-backed options struggling borrowers can ask lenders for (term extension, temporary interest-only, new deals) and credit-file implications

entries.title: Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances
entries.why: Canonical HMRC guide with current 2026/27 Personal Allowance (£12,570) and tax bands (20%/40%/45%)

entries.title: Income Tax: introduction
entries.why: Official overview of what income is taxable, tax-free allowances, and how Income Tax is paid

entries.title: National Insurance: introduction
entries.why: Official guide to what NI is, contribution classes, eligibility, and what contributions qualify you for

entries.title: National Insurance rates and categories
entries.why: Authoritative 2026/27 employee and employer NI contribution rate tables by category letter

entries.title: Self-employed National Insurance rates
entries.why: Current 2026/27 Class 2 and Class 4 rates and profit thresholds for the self-employed

entries.title: Capital Gains Tax: what you pay it on, rates and allowances
entries.why: Canonical CGT guide with Annual Exempt Amount (£3,000), 18%/24% rates, and taxable-asset rules

entries.title: Tax on dividends
entries.why: Official guide with the £500 dividend allowance and 2026/27 dividend tax rates by band

entries.title: Marriage Allowance
entries.why: Official rules for transferring £1,260 of Personal Allowance to a spouse/civil partner, with eligibility criteria

entries.title: Self Assessment tax returns
entries.why: Canonical guide to who must file, deadlines, penalties, and corrections for Self Assessment

entries.title: Check how to register for Self Assessment
entries.why: Official registration paths for self-employed, partners, and others who must send a return

entries.title: Tax codes
entries.why: Official explanation of tax code numbers/letters, emergency codes, and the standard 1257L code

entries.title: Options for dealing with your debts
entries.why: Official multi-part GOV.UK guide covering breathing space, debt management plans, administration orders, IVAs and DROs with eligibility rules

entries.title: Debt Respite Scheme (Breathing Space) guidance for creditors
entries.why: Insolvency Service statutory guidance with the concrete scheme rules: 60-day standard moratorium, mental-health-crisis moratorium duration (treatment + 30 days), interest/charge freezes

entries.title: Benefits calculators
entries.why: GOV.UK's official list of independent free benefits calculators (Policy in Practice, entitledto, Turn2us) plus who can and cannot use them

entries.title: Check benefits and financial support you can get
entries.why: Official GOV.UK smart-answer tool for entitlements overview based on circumstances (location, employment, disability, caring, finances)

entries.title: Budgeting Loans
entries.why: Official rules and current figures for Social Fund Budgeting Loans: £100 minimum, £348/£464/£812 caps, 6-month qualifying-benefit rule, UC claimants directed to Budgeting Advance

entries.title: Apply for Council Tax Reduction
entries.why: Official eligibility and application route for Council Tax Reduction (up to 100% off) — core cost-of-living support for low-income households

entries.title: Dealing with the financial impact of rising costs of living
entries.why: Regulator's consumer page on what support lenders must give borrowers struggling with mortgage/credit repayments — authoritative on firms' obligations

entries.title: Protect yourself from scams (FCA)
entries.why: FCA's core consumer scam-protection page (successor to ScamSmart): warning signs, Firm Checker, Warning List, reporting routes.

entries.title: FCA Warning List of unauthorised firms
entries.why: The regulator's own daily-updated warning list (18,347 entries at fetch) and the fact that unauthorised-firm dealings lose FOS/FSCS protection.

entries.title: FCA Firm Checker (Financial Services Register)
entries.why: Official tool/page for verifying a firm is FCA-authorised with permission for the specific service — the canonical authorised-firm check.

entries.title: How to complain (FCA — firm complaints and the Financial Ombudsman)
entries.why: Authoritative FOS-route facts: 6-year/3-year complaint window, 8-week firm response deadline, 15/35 business days for payment firms, 6 months to go to FOS.

entries.title: How to claim compensation if a firm fails (FCA/FSCS)
entries.why: Regulator's step-by-step FSCS claim process when an authorised firm fails — the consumer-protection backstop for this domain.

entries.title: Avoid and report internet scams and phishing
entries.why: Official GOV.UK guide with the concrete reporting channels for suspicious emails, texts, websites and adverts (multi-part guide).

entries.title: Check a list of genuine HMRC contacts
entries.why: HMRC's canonical collection for verifying whether an email, call, letter or text claiming to be HMRC is genuine — key anti-tax-scam check.

entries.title: Register for VAT
entries.why: Corpus-gap report: VAT registration was the top measured gap (2 distinct questions, the only concept above the reporting floor). Covers the registration threshold, when registration is compulsory vs voluntary, and how to register

entries.title: VAT rates
entries.why: Companion to the registration guide: the standard, reduced and zero rates people ask for by number

entries.title: Understanding off-payroll working (IR35)
entries.why: Corpus-gap report: 'ir35' was named as an uncovered concept. The definitive HMRC explainer of who the off-payroll rules apply to and who decides status

entries.title: How Inheritance Tax works: thresholds, rules and allowances
entries.why: Corpus-gap report: two IHT questions were refused, one naming 'nil' (the residence nil-rate band). Covers the GBP 325,000 threshold, the residence nil-rate band and spouse transfers

entries.title: How Council Tax works
entries.why: Corpus-gap report: a council-tax banding question was refused naming 'banding'. NOTE deliberately /council-tax (11k chars of prose) and NOT /council-tax-bands, which is a transaction page with a zero-length body - the known prose-less-page trap

entries.title: Warm Home Discount Scheme
entries.why: Corpus-gap report: 'warm' was named as uncovered. Eligibility and the discount amount for the named scheme people ask about

entries.title: Help with your energy bills
entries.why: Corpus-gap report: an energy-bills help question was refused naming 'energy'. The official index of energy-cost support
